name: stopots-autofill
description: Unit tests for Stopots Chrome extension

scripts.build:dict: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),m='// END GENERATED DATA',f='dictionary.js',t=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!t.includes(m))throw new Error(m+' marker missing in '+f);fs.writeFileSync(f,'const DICTIONARY = '+JSON.stringify(require('../dictionary.json'),null,2)+';\n\n'+m+t.split(m)[1])"
